messages:
Iris (CS): Heads-up — several trial/onboard tenants reporting missing documents after tonight's index migration. Need a short external status and an internal RCA plan.
Jon (CS): How many tenants affected and who are top-priority?
Iris (CS): 14 tenants affected, 9 blocked activations. High-priority list in the ticket: Nimbus, PaperTrail, Tutorly.
Priya (Eng): Initial triage: migration job triggered global dedupe pass that rebalanced shard assignments. That caused temporary write stalls and retry amplification. We applied a targeted mitigation at 02:41 UTC to bypass the heavy dedupe for pending writes.
Priya (Eng): After mitigation, write throughput recovered; reingest progressing at ~700 docs/min for priority tenants. ETA ~1.5 hours for the first three, full catch-up depends on document counts.
Kai (Product): Comms ask: (A) short status email with ETA + contact path, (B) offer a small goodwill credit for blocked activations, (C) schedule an enablement session for technical Q&A and to capture feedback.
Iris (CS): Draft external status: "We detected delayed document ingestion related to a scheduled migration. Engineers implemented a mitigation and reindexing is underway. Priority accounts should see progress within 2 hours. We'll follow up with a full RCA and a live Q&A session for impacted teams." Feedback?
Jon (CS): Add: where to reply + we will apply a one-time credit equal to 3 platform days for blocked activations. Also include a link to incident page: https://status.redwood.example/incidents/1729009999
Priya (Eng): Note for RCA: root cause is the unbounded dedupe window during migration and lack of per-tenant write isolation. Fixes: rate-limit dedupe work, add per-tenant queue caps, and instrument queue-length alerts. I'll draft infra section.
infra-bot: Hotfix v2026.07.02-dedupe-skip promoted to prod at 1729009900. CI checks: passed. :white_check_mark:
Kai (Product): I'll set an office hour at 13:00 UTC today, share calendar invite + short agenda (what happened, mitigation, Q&A). Add a one-question feedback poll in the invite.
Iris (CS): Jon please own immediate replies for Nimbus + PaperTrail. I'll take Tutorly.
Jon (CS): Taking Nimbus and PaperTrail. Messaging: short apology, ETA, offer credit + invite to office hour.
Iris (CS): Perfect. After office hour we'll collect notes and fold into the RCA. Action items: Priya -> infra postmortem section, Kai -> public timeline + office hour invite, Jon -> per-tenant reply log, Iris -> final external RCA and credit application.
Iris (CS): Sending status email now and will paste the sent template here.
Jon (CS): Thanks — will update ticket when customers respond.
Priya (Eng): I'll follow up in 2 hours with final queue drain status and estimated time for remaining tenants.
Iris (CS): Closing loop for now. We'll publish RCA & preventive timeline tomorrow. :thumbsup:
